title: Izwi Lokuhlakanipha Ezithunzini
intro: Umuntu wasendulo, owaziwa ngokuqonda okujulile, ukhuluma nawe emakhulwini eminyaka. Lo muntu akazange azisho ukuthi ungumprofethi, kodwa ukuhlakanipha kwaphezulu kwageleza emazwini akhe. Njengomzali oshiye ifa elingunaphakade lesiqondiso, iseluleko sakhe sisalokhu sigcinwe ezinhliziyweni zezigidi zabantu, siphindaphindwa futhi sicatshangelwe kuze kube namuhla.
clues: Ngathola isipho saphezulu esangihlukanisa - ukuhlakanipha okujulile kangangokuthi kwaba uphawu lwami oluchazayo kuwo wonke umlando.
Ngangingesona isithunywa noma ingelosi - umphefumulo nje obusiswe ngokuqonda okujulile kanye nokuqonda umhlaba.
Ubuhlobo bami obuseduze kakhulu babuphakathi kwengane yami, futhi ngalesi sibopho, umyalezo wami ohlala isikhathi eside wathunyelwa.
Nganxusa ukubonga kuLowo onginike konke, futhi ngaxwayisa ngokuqhosha nokuzikhukhumeza.
Ngafundisa ngesisindo sezenzo ngisho nembewu yesinaphi, kanye nokubaluleka kokwehlisa izwi lakho ngokuthobeka.
Isahluko e-Quran sinegama lami, lapho iseluleko sami endodaneni yami ethandekayo sigcinwa khona kuze kube phakade.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
